name: Bristly Barrier
description: Surround your target with a bristly barrier, granting them a Damage Shield that deals 10 damage when hit for 10 minutes.

name: Bristly Tunic
description: Wrap yourself in a bristly tunic, increasing your Armor Class by 15 and granting you a Damage Shield that deals 3 damage when hit for 1 hour.

name: Nature Arrows
description: Imbue your arrows with nature, increasing your Ranged Damage dealt by 1 (L1) to 7 (L60) Magic Damage and granting you a chance to activate Nature Arrow Advantage on ranged attacks. Nature Arrow Advantage: Seize the advantage, reducing the cast time of your next spell in the Root, Snare, or Swarm line by 100% for 10 seconds.

name: Imbue Weapon: Nature
description: Imbue your weapon with nature, granting you a chance to activate Nature Attack on melee attacks for 15 minutes. Nature Attack: Unleash a nature attack, dealing 7 (L1) to 75 (L60) Magic Damage.

name: Stinging Swarm
description: Engulf your target in a stinging swarm, dealing 20 Poison Damage every 6 seconds for 1 minute.

name: Lesser Regeneration
description: Lightly regenerate your target, increasing their Health Regeneration by 5 for 30 minutes.

name: Heal
description: Moderately heal your target, restoring 57 Health.
